desc: Upgrade your kitchen with the GE Countertop Microwave Oven, a 1100 watt microwave countertop with 1.4 cu. ft. capacity designed for powerful, even cooking. This 1100 watt countertop microwave oven delivers fast results for everyday meals, making it a reliable kitchen microwave for home, dorm room microwave setups, or office use. Advanced sensor cooking controls automatically adjust time and power for optimal results, while one-touch controls and 7 convenience cook settings make operation simple and efficient. The digital display and electronic keypad provide precise control, and the defrost function ensures evenly thawed food without overcooking edges. This microwave oven countertop model features a durable glass turntable for consistent heating and trusted GE performance for daily use. Ideal as a microwave for college dorm, college microwave, or microwave kitchen essential, it also includes a child lock for added safety in shared spaces. A dependable counter microwave built for convenience, performance, and everyday cooking.
